title: Catalog is renamed Part Library in the menu, page title and edit window
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the build under test with access to the Parts area.
custom_steps:
1. Read the Parts left-menu entry.
  2. Open that screen and read the page title.
  3. Open the dialog for editing a library entry and read its title.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Parts left-menu entry reads "Part Library" (was "Catalog"); the page title on that screen reads "Part Library" (was "Catalog").
  • The dialog for editing a library entry is titled "Edit Library Part" (was "Edit Catalog Part"); the "New Catalog Part" create title is gone with the control itself.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 12 (Rename Catalog to Part Library); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R1: “The Parts left menu entry reads Part Library. It read Catalog.”
  • S12-R2: “The page title on that screen reads Part Library. It read Catalog.”
  • S12-R3: “The dialog for editing a library entry is titled Edit Library Part. It was titled Edit Catalog Part. The create title, New Catalog Part, disappears with the control itself per S11-R1.”
